name: Orbiter
notes: Default: the official Orbiter symbol for light backgrounds (light-logo-mobile.svg in Orbiter-Finance/OrbiterFE-V2: the alien in its UFO, red #EF2F2D -> #89272D alien, #434344 -> #000 UFO, #2D2F31 details), paths and gradients unchanged. It replaces a grey UI icon recoloured red that dropped the UFO
Inverted: the official dark-theme symbol (dark-logo-mobile.svg, same geometry with a white UFO and details), for dark backgrounds where the default's near-black UFO vanishes
Mono: the same paths in currentColor; the alien's eye stays a hole with the pupil as ink, as in the colored symbol
